body: Orchestrator review of PR #225 head 1128abb (three commits 2360aea, c636452, 1128abb; 9 files) from git objects. Rule, SKILL and README: make upgrade pin flow rewritten (operator runs it in the canonical clone; whole pin diff + tests/** expected-version sync travel in one worker PR through make require-crit-review; orchestrator never pushes a repository change to main; boundary/acceptance overrides named), no-worker-is-not-opt-out activation case, pane-less SessionStart contract updated to summary line + directive line, grep proves no stale 'prints one line' carrier; test_agmsg_orchestration_docs parity extended. Launcher: print_regime_directive / claim_seat_and_print_directive inject the agmsg-orchestration: directive after seat_claim= and in the pane-less summary; main_push_guard (ORCH_PUSH_MAIN=acceptance|boundary, fast-forward only, delete refused, tree diff git diff --name-only --no-renames <remote> <local>, fail-closed when the diff cannot be listed, logged to <git-common-dir>/orch-push-main.log); install_main_push_guard writes a constant stub that execs herdr-agents --main-push-guard only when the launcher's --help advertises it, otherwise refuses main updates only; stub installed only once the deployed launcher has the mode; identical stub without the execute bit gets chmod 755; differing hooks (edited or foreign) left alone with a warning. Pin tests: v2026.9.12 floor (#160) with exactness held by generate-agent-configs.py --check. 718 unit tests OK, render-check, validate-agent-assets exit 0, shfmt/shellcheck clean, scratch-remote demos pasted (evil merge refused, unlistable diff refused, stale launcher passes branch and refuses main, bootstrap skip notice, execute bit restored). CI green on macOS 14 and both Ubuntu matrices incl. bats; mergeStateStatus CLEAN.
author: claude-code

body: Round 2 (c636452): make upgrade runs agmsg-bootstrap from source before the launcher is applied, so the stub exec'd an installed launcher without --main-push-guard; that launcher took the flag as DIR, ran remove_shadowing_node_global (npm uninstall -g) and failed, breaking every push of every branch (Codex GitHub review P1; Codex audit P1; orchestrator confirmed against the installed launcher and the Makefile).
